description: 15-bay truss deployed one bay at a time; docking impulse at the tip; root stress grows linearly with deployed length. Regenerated after the review 7B fixes: chord area and bay height are read from these parameters (no longer hard-coded), and deployed length is the tip extent: 72.5 m centre + 2.5 m half-bay = 75 m, giving 50.0 MPa root stress.
